def record_customer(customer_id, customer_ids=[]):
    """Return IDs belonging only to this independent request."""
    customer_ids.append(customer_id)
    return customer_ids

from app import record_customer

def test_independent_requests():
    first = record_customer("A")
    second = record_customer("B")
    assert first == ["A"]
    assert second == ["B"]
    assert first is not second

def test_any_object():
    marker = object()
    assert record_customer(marker)[0] is marker
    assert record_customer(None) == [None]
